## Prose stays a quote

> Note that this is a quote.

> Tips are welcome.

> Information is power.

> Warning signs were everywhere.

> Note

> **Warn**

> Note : a space before the colon.

> `Note:` in code.

## Colon markers

> Info: the build is nightly.

> Note: this is worth knowing.

> Warn: this deletes data.

> Warning: this deletes data too.

> Tip: use the cache.

> **Note:** emphasised with the colon inside.

> **Note**: emphasised with the colon outside.

> *Tip:* in italics.

> Notes:

> NOTE: shouting.

> wArNiNgS: mixed case.

> <!-- Info -->
> A marker kept off the page.

## Every word in the colon syntax

> Important: blue, as GitHub's is.

> Hint: green.

> Success: green.

> Attention: yellow.

> Caution: red.

> Danger: red.

> Error: red.

> **Errors:** a plural.

> <!-- danger -->
> A comment chooses red.

## A quoted log line is a marker too

> Error: connection refused

> Success: 3 files written

## GitHub alerts

> [!NOTE]
> GitHub's note.

> [!TIP]
> GitHub's tip.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> GitHub's important.

> [!WARNING]
> GitHub's warning.

> [!CAUTION]
> GitHub's caution.

> [!DANGER]
>
> Not one of GitHub's types.
